tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Resolve a city, town or station/airport code in India to Yaanmitra place ids, with its state and whether it has an airport and a railway station. Use it when a name is ambiguous or misspelt, or to check whether a town has an airport or station. compare_trip and rental_options also accept plain names

tools.name: compare_trip
tools.description: Compare flights, trains, buses, outstation cabs, self-drive cars, rental bikes, rideshares and mixed routes between two places in India, read from travel sites' public pages. Returns options grouped by mode with the cheapest and fastest, departure/arrival times (India time), fares labelled "listed"

tools.name: rental_options
tools.description: List scooters/motorbikes and self-drive cars on rent inside one city in India (e.g. Goa, Bengaluru, Manali), read from rental sites' public city pages (Royal Brothers, Rentrip, Sukuto, Revv and others).
